question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Gregarious
solution:
The correct answer is: **Sociable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gregarious **means fond of company; sociable. (संगति का शौकीन; मिलनसार)

 
 
• **For example**: *She is a gregarious person and loves to socialize with people.*
 
 
 
• ​Marked option **Sociable **means enjoying being with other people; friendly. (जिसे लोगों से मिलना-जुलना अच्‍छा लगे; मिलनसार, प्‍यार-मुहब्‍बत वाला)
 
 
• **For example**:* Her sociable manner is really a mask of very shy nature.*
 
 
 
• *​*From here, it is clear that 'Sociable' is the most appropriate synonym.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anti-social** means unwilling or unable to associate in a normal or friendly way with other people. (अन्य लोगों के साथ सामान्य या मैत्रीपूर्ण तरीके से जुड़ने में अनिच्छुक या असमर्थ)
 
• **Introvert **means a shy, reticent person who tends to be inward-looking and introspective. (एक शर्मीला, मितभाषी व्यक्ति जो अंतर्मुखी और आत्मविश्लेषी होता है)
 
• **Excited **means feeling or showing enthusiasm and eagerness. (उत्साह और उत्सुकता महसूस करना या दिखाना)
